cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We're claiming for your lost bag. At four, were you on the bus or buying coffee? You've told me both. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coffee. Can we finish the form?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Was the bag beside you when you paid?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver waited while I ran in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So both fit. Tell me the boarding bit again: did the bag come back out with you?

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 tests bag presence and A5 reconciles accounts before probing boarding, but the Stance is only announced rather than responding to B impatience.

responseLogic.evidence: B4 waiting bus explains why the broader journey can include coffee at four; the inquiry should not assume bag returned without asking.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the form finished and B4 gives a useful temporal bridge between accounts.

heightening.evidence: B4 waiting detail makes A5 accept compatibility and ask the next precise custody question.

specificity.evidence: A1 lost bag, four oclock and bus/coffee establish the claim and apparent discrepancy.

brevityWit.evidence: A1 voluntary please and A3 rank clause add bulk without relieving B task.

coach2.missing: A response to B2 impatience that enacts the Stance.
coach2.firstDefect: A3 adjustment is stated but not given.

reservation: Preserve the willingness to reconcile evidence; do not turn this into an accusation that must be proved.
